## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the situation before describing the solution.

## Who is affected

Which audience does this serve: content creators, administrators, students on the mobile view, or visitors on the public site?

## Proposed solution

What you would like to see happen.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you set them aside.

## Scope and impact

- [ ] Requires a change in `educado-api`
- [ ] Adds new user-facing strings (they must be added to both `pt-BR` and `en-US` in `src/shared/i18n/index.ts`)
- [ ] Affects the mobile student views under `/student/*`
- [ ] Affects the public, unauthenticated pages
- [ ] Adds a new runtime dependency

## Design references

Mockups, sketches or links, if you have them.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps evaluate the proposal.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched the existing issues and this is not a duplicate.
- [ ] This keeps the stack as it is: vanilla TypeScript with Vite, no UI framework.
